parameters.name: DstEntityId
parameters.description: The destination entity ID. You can use the table or column ID returned by the ListTables or ListColumns operation, or a custom entity ID.

parameters.name: DstEntityName
parameters.description: The destination entity name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: NeedAttachRelationship
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return lineage relationship information. Default value: false.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Default value: Asc. Valid values:
- Asc: ascending order.
- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Default value: Name, which sorts by lineage entity name.

parameters.name: SrcEntityId
parameters.description: The source entity ID. You can use the table or column ID returned by the ListTables or ListColumns operation, or a custom entity ID.

parameters.name: SrcEntityName
parameters.description: The source entity name. Fuzzy match is supported.
